tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search extended-stay hotels, motels, and furnished housing for work travel lodging near a city, neighborhood, hospital, worksite, or landmark. Intended for travel nurses, construction crews, outage workers, and others on assignments lasting weeks or months. Resolves destination internally; verified

tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description: Return undated hotel or motel facts, photos, and amenities by propertyId from a search result or directly by hotelName. Optional destination narrows a named-hotel match. Furnished homes require a propertyRef from search results and cannot be queried by name alone.

tools.name: get_hotel_offers
tools.description: Return live room offers for a hotel or motel for explicit dates and guests, including multi-week work stays. tools.name: get_home_details
tools.description: Return photos, amenities, and property facts for a furnished home selected from search results. Requires that home's signed propertyRef; a home name alone is insufficient. Search results include each home's name, position, and propertyRef.

tools.name: get_home_offers
tools.description: Refresh the availability and estimated full-stay price for a furnished home selected from search results. Requires that home's signed propertyRef. Omitted dates or guests retain the original search stay. The result is an estimate subject to host confirmation, not a hotel room offer.
